sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Data Scientist
Maersk
03/2023 - 08/2025,
Achievements/Tasks
Developed an Enterprise Document Intelligence platform to extract,
classify, and structure insights from 35,000+ unstructured business
documents. Designed analytics workflows to transform raw text into
actionable intelligence, enabling faster decision-making and
improved reporting accuracy. Integrated advanced retrieval
mechanisms for scalable access to key business information,
reducing manual effort and enhancing operational efficiency.
Led and contributed to the development of the Container Gate
Time Prediction Model , collaborating across teams to enhance
container flow efficiency. The model delivered $1M in cost
savings.
Integrated MLOps best practices using Airflow, MLflow, and Azure ,
reducing manual intervention and enhancing automation.
AI Analyst
Pixis
03/2022 - 01/2023,
Achievements/Tasks
Developed an audience insights dashboard for Google and
Facebook Ads by aligning with product, marketing, and sales
teams. Led discussions with stakeholders to define key metrics,
improving ad targeting by 20%.
Used GPT-3 model to develop an AI-driven advertisement generator
fine-tuned pipelines, enabling the marketing team to create
engaging, personalized ad campaigns that boosted customer
engagement by 30% .
Person Tracking and Re-identification
The goal of the project was to uniquely identify a person in a video
frame. Used YOLO algorithm to detect persons .
Siamese Network to re-identify and track the person through unique
features from the body. Used MTCNN to extract face and Facenet model to
re-identify through unique facial features.
